description:
The standard Monark site header: sticky, 64px, translucent background
with a blur and a bottom border. Desktop (`lg` and up): brand, links,
then the actions pushed right. Below `lg`: the brand and a menu button
that opens a full-height sheet with the links and the actions.

props.name: brand
props.description: Left slot: the product brand, usually `<SiteBrand />`.

props.name: links
props.description: Up to four links to the site's own pages, shown 28px after the brand.

props.name: pathname
props.description: Current pathname, used to mark the active link (e.g. `usePathname()`).

props.name: LinkComponent
props.description: Link component for the page links. Default: a plain `<a>`.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Right slot, in this order: `<DemoChip />`, `<LocaleSwitch />`,
`<ThemeToggle />`, then one primary action.

props.name: mobileActions
props.description: What the mobile sheet shows under the links. Defaults to `actions`.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner row (max width, side padding).

description:
The site's own page links: Nunito Sans 600 at 14px in `muted-foreground`,
the current page in `foreground` with `aria-current="page"`.
